what: Tetra Tech is a consulting and engineering firm specialising in water and the environment: water supply and treatment, environmental remediation, climate adaptation and international development work.
customers: Water utilities, environmental agencies, the American and British governments, and international aid programmes.
money: federal, state and local government programmes
moat: Depth in water and environmental work specifically, where regulatory knowledge and a track record of approved designs are what win framework contracts.
risks: American foreign aid cuts removed a meaningful part of the international development work
Revenue fell from $5.4B to $5.1B as a result
22 times earnings for a business whose growth has stalled
opportunities: An 8.7% net margin, high for consulting, with $503M of free cash flow
Analysts see about 14% upside, with 6 covering the stock
Water infrastructure and PFAS remediation are long-term programmes funded for years ahead
watch: Backlog excluding the lost aid work, and net service revenue growth.
